timeouts.wait_timeout: ends only the caller wait and never cancels the operation
timeouts.operation_deadline: requests cancellation and normally ends Cancelled with reason deadline
timeouts.protocol_timeout: fails the operation in the controller error domain after a bounded handshake or ACK exchange
timeouts.transport_write_timeout: bounds partial report and command writes independently from protocol replies

operations.terminal_commit: exactly once; immutable result and error are mutually exclusive

runtime.final_handle_drop: synchronously enters Closing and rejects admission, then delegates the remaining close sequence to a dedicated finalizer without waiting or invoking resource callbacks on the dropping thread; explicit close synchronously observes Closed only from outside bound supervised tasks, while a bound task caller is rejected before Runtime state changes
runtime.close_panic: a ManagedResource close panic is isolated while healthy resources continue closing, but its resource and task registrations remain supervised and Runtime does not claim Closed; every unexpected internal close panic leaves Runtime in Closing, terminates events with runtime.close_panicked when possible, and wakes close waiters so later close calls fail instead of blocking
close_order: wait for ordinary supervised task cleanup
assert task and resource registries are empty

events.overflow: oldest ordinary events are summarized by EventGap; authoritative state remains queryable
events.close: RuntimeClosed bypasses subscriber severity and log filters, is the final delivered event after successful close, leaves subscriptions drainable, and rejects later publish attempts; an unexpected internal close panic uses runtime.close_panicked as the final event when event production is still open

controller.report_interval_scope: every report, including cancellation and close neutralization
controller.direct_success_boundary: the complete report bytes were accepted by transport

sequence.origin: monotonic time when the command lane acquires the sequence
sequence.offsets: absolute from origin and monotonically non-decreasing
sequence.same_offset: apply in input order and emit one merged report
sequence.drift: targets never derive from the previous dispatch
sequence.cancel_or_failure: remove pending steps, accept a neutral report when connected, then release lease and commit terminal state

controller.automation_lease: exclusive arbitration primitive only; ECS is outside this milestone

classifications.rule: button, HAT, stick, handshake, and 7-bit report bytes match the audited source
sequence timing uses validated absolute monotonic offsets instead of the source constructor defect
cancellation and failure neutralize before terminal observation and lease release is observable
late ACK generations cannot complete a later request
